note: Eleven chapter I phrase candidates checked against source spans and existing published identities. Se mettre à uses the existing reflexive-begin sense with a planned new met surface; no expression imported or approved.

items.decision: The hyphenated adverb is one orthographic token meaning immediately. Index it as vocabulary surface+sense, not independent multiword expression mastery.

Check the indexed occurrence and page context during import.
Restrictive negation is productive grammar, with existing vocabulary identities for restriction; this is a representative source span, not exhaustive workwide expression indexing.

items.decision: All three occurrences mean begin an action. The two Micromégas past se mit à uses match the already published mit + reflexive-begin identity, which should keep its mastery and questions. The present se met à links a new met surface to the same reflexive-begin sense under the chapter I identity plan, while retaining separate mastery for met versus mit. The other published begin sense under mirent stays unchanged. Keep the whole phrase out of independent expression mastery; import the present surface only after complete work signoff.
